# YourDictionary.com

> > YourDictionary.com provides comprehensive example sentences demonstrating real-world usage of English words, phrases, idioms, and specialized terminology across general, legal, business, and technical contexts.

This dictionary resource helps users understand how words and phrases are used in context through curated example sentences. The site covers everyday vocabulary, legal terminology, business jargon, idiomatic expressions, and domain-specific language to support writers, students, and language learners.
